title: Prepare planning ignore rules
responsibility: Prepare additions to existing clean registry and formatter ignore files for planning artifacts.

inputs.name: planRegistry.git
inputs.description: Repository Git handle used by the path-safety and clean-worktree checks and to read paths and blobs at the selected revision. Returned bytes are proposed changes; this function does not write them.

inputs.name: planRegistry.revision
inputs.description: Git revision whose tree supplies the existing .prettierignore and harness.units.json contents. Files absent at that revision are not created.

outputs.name: planningIgnores
outputs.description: Array of ignore globs for planning artifact folders under the seven supported categories. Each category excludes plan.json, .gitattributes, and files under designs/ and threads/.

outputs.name: planRegistry
outputs.description: Promise resolving to a map from changed repository paths to replacement bytes. It may contain .prettierignore and/or harness.units.json when those files exist, pass path and cleanliness checks, and need missing patterns; it never writes files.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when path-safety or clean-worktree checks reject .prettierignore or harness.units.json, or when an existing harness.units.json is invalid JSON or fails unitsConfigSchema.safeParse. Errors from awaited Git reads also propagate.
